name: onboarding

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows step two with its title, the three choices, the dots and both navigation buttons.

tagline: A short setup card steps through dots, choices and Next.
summary: A bordered setup card that walks through a few steps: dot progress at the top, a serif title and description, step content, then Back and Next buttons, with Start Creating on the last step.
appearance: A rounded bordered card on dark holds a centred row of three small dots, a serif heading in white and a grey description. Step content sits below, with two pill buttons at the bottom: a muted Back and a white Next.
behaviour: Clicking Next advances the dots and swaps the step content; Back returns and sits disabled on the first step. On the final step Next turns into Start Creating. Choice rows lighten on hover.
demo_content: Steps Welcome to StashUI, Pick your style, You're all set; options Minimal, Vibrant and System default.
search_phrases: install wizard steps with back and next
guided setup for a new user
use_when: A product needs a short, self-contained first-run setup with a few steps and choices.
avoid_when: The flow needs many steps or saved progress: it is a small card with no persistence.
customise: Root takes totalSteps, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, maxStepValue, onComplete and canGoNext; steps, header, indicator and navigation are composed as child parts.
weight_why: A small card with conditional steps and CSS dot transitions; no animation library.

a11y.note: The step indicator is a labelled progressbar and the choice group is a labelled radiogroup, so this has a solid baseline.

issues: The options in the demo are plain divs, so clicking Minimal, Vibrant or System default changes nothing.
The disabled Back button on step one is so faint it nearly disappears.
polish_why: Clean serif type and clear dot progress; the unwired option rows and faint Back button are rough.
title: Onboarding
